instance: EEX THE trade and top-of-book factual audit 20260921
scope: Scoped factual contribution for P5 Gas Quarterly arms A0 Calendar-only baseline and A1 S1 candidate, derived only from the observed EEX THE NatGas trade and top-of-book lake paths.
method: One row per information requirement informed by this execution instance. Each row carries the eight frozen §6.3 fields with source locators and observed evidence. Requirements this lake does not inform are listed in notContributed and preserve the accepted ST-03.1 values unchanged.

guards.reconciliationRequired: Final candidate readiness requires Command reconciliation of this contribution with the ST-03.3 temporal contribution and the accepted ST-03.1 matrix.

rows.requirement: Execution price series at eligible decision boundaries for the exact Gas Quarterly contract
rows.missionAndCandidate: Quarterly (Gas) / A0 Calendar-only baseline + A1 S1 candidate
rows.sourceType: market data: EEX THE NatGas derivative trade prints and top-of-book quotes, Parquet lake

historicalCoverage.value: Observed scope only: trade 2020-11-02..2026-07-28 (1464 partitions, 2801 files, 282693 rows, 51080320 bytes); top-of-book 2025-07-25..2026-07-28 (257 partitions, 9251 files, 94714717 rows, 7490373724 bytes).

pointInTimeValidity.reason: The lake carries _retrieved_at_utc values in 2026 (bulk extraction, e.g. 2026-06-06T00:00:00Z and 2026-06-10T06:55:24Z) and Tm reference/occurrence timestamps. No publication-at-source or contemporaneous policy-consumable evidence exists, so decision-time (Replay) consumption at historical boundaries is not demonstrated (§6.1).

rows.shortValidationNote: Real EEX THE NatGas trade and top-of-book prices exist for the observed scope and are available for evaluation-view use. Decision-time availability is NOT_DEMONSTRATED: publication and policy-consumable timestamps are absent, so this evidence supports the requirement's availability but not yet Replay causality.

rows.sourceType: market data instrument metadata carried per row (UOM, Currency, InstrumentISIN, ProductISIN, ExpiryDate, Maturity, InstrumentType, ShortCode, DisplayName)

historicalCoverage.value: Observed sample only: every inspected trade and top-of-book row carries UOM=MWh and Currency=EUR; exact identifiers observed include ProductISIN DE000A0MEW81/DE000A0MEW99 (and DE000A0G9FX0, DE000A0MEXA7 in trade) and InstrumentISIN per contract. Lot size, tick size and delivery profile are NOT present.

rows.shortValidationNote: Partial observed evidence only: row-level units (MWh/EUR) and contract identifiers are present and reproducible in the observed sample, but the requirement is 'units AND contract specifications'. Lot size, tick, rounding and delivery profile are absent, so the full critical requirement is NOT available and R-08 remains in criticalMissing.

historicalCoverage.value: Observed sample only: trade sample 1701 rows, 34 rows (~2%) missing DisplayName/ExpiryDate/InstrumentISIN/Maturity; 587 rows without Px (volume-only). Top-of-book sample 533108 rows, 153972 rows (~29%) missing DisplayName/ExpiryDate/InstrumentISIN/Maturity, with one-sided books (empty BidPx 64897, empty AskPx 42814). Duplicate _row_sha256 observed in top-of-book sample (167); duplicate TrdID in trade sample (34) coexists with UpdtAct New/Delete, suggesting update actions rather than proven duplication.
